description: This file defines an interface and a template class for hash stream processing, including support for HMAC, within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace.

classes.name: IHashStream
classes.description: An interface for hash stream operations, including methods for retrieving hash type, resetting, obtaining result, and inputting data.

classes.name: HashStreamType
classes.description: A template class implementing hash streaming and HMAC support, parameterized by the hash algorithm and hash type.

methods.name: Result
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the hash result.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the hash output.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Inputs data into the hash stream.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of hash used.
